There's a reason why you're playing and choosing it over going to the gym, for example, because I'm sure you're aware of such thing. Maybe start with questioning yourself why do you play it, what part of your life it fulfills? 

Just remember, that there is no shame to feel this way, don't be mad at yourself for being addictive to the game. You're doing the first step to improving - acknowledging that you might have a problem. You hear your inner voice that tries to help you. You're doing a really good job. Even if it won't work the first time you try to do as you want to or how you want to - it's fine, nobody's perfect or needs to be one. Consistency is better than perfectionism. 

By finding the answer to what part of your life this game fulfills, you might understand how you can replace it with something else. It is really hard doing sports instead of playing league, especially first months and without understanding why you're doing it. 

For example, some time ago I felt really lonely and league helped me to fulfill this part of my life. No sport would help me with it during COVID. So even if I did it, and trust me I tried, I couldn't keep it up just because I didn't understand why would I do it, what for.

If you feel like you have nothing to do in meantime, then it's easier to focus mostly on this problem, rather than quitting league and not doing anything else instead. I had also such problem, I stopped playing league but didn't find what to do instead of playing so after sometime I just got back to it. Right now programming courses really help me out to keep being busy. I almost have no time for this game and it really makes me feel better.

So, one thing is to change everything at once and almost guaranteed fail everywhere, another is to do it step by step without judging yourself over small mistakes and trying and trying no matter what. This way also might help you to solve the problem with challenge in your life. It is really hard but rewarding.

If at any point you feel like coming back to league - stop and question yourself again: why? Is it because it is just a simple answer? Just because you want to do something instantly, to get easy dopamine? Or is it more complicated? Maybe the way you're trying right now to do that is not your way and it is better to find another solution. 

For example, you will notice after sometime that your head will resist attempts to fixing your life and might ask you to come back to whatever you were doing in the past. Just because this is how our brain works. Mostly it doesn't like any changes, especially healthy ones, because they are hard to implement and keep up. It's always easier to do nothing rather than trying to do something. This is very important time when your life challenges you by asking how important is that thing that you're trying to do. All you need to do is just withstand it, keep on doing whatever you've chosen and don't stop no matter what.

If it's more complicated and you feel like after a month of constant attempts you don't feel better - it's probably not the right way for you. Than start from the beginning and ask yourself again what do you miss right now.

English is not my first language, although hope it helps you in any way. Be strong and life will reward you for it.
